headline: US CENTCOM Strikes IRGC Targets Across Iran Following Ballistic Missile Interceptions
subheadline: CENTCOM conducted intensive strikes on IRGC command centers, missile facilities, and naval capabilities in Iran after intercepting ballistic missiles targeting US forces.
lede: US CENTCOM launched intensive strikes on dozens of IRGC targets across Iran in response to Iranian ballistic missile attacks on US forces. Simultaneously, IDF operations continued in southern Lebanon against Hezbollah underground infrastructure and in Gaza against Hamas weapons caches. Regional tensions escalated with IRGC naval seizures in the Strait of Hormuz and US-Saudi joint strikes on pro-Iran militias in Iraq. At least four explosions struck Ahvaz, Khuzestan province, causing power outages in Golestan where the MOIS building is located.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Intensify Across Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian forces launched multiple missile and drone strikes across Ukraine, targeting infrastructure and military positions. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 65 Russian drones overnight, causing casualties and infrastructure damage in Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson. Russian forces advanced near Druzhkovsky urban community, engaging in ground combat. Ukrainian Defense Minister Khmara stated intent to end the war within 14 years to prevent youth conscription.

sections.title: US Strikes Iran Amid Escalating Regional Tensions
sections.body: US CENTCOM conducted intensive strikes on IRGC command centers, missile facilities, and naval capabilities in Iran on July 29. At least four explosions struck Ahvaz, Khuzestan province, causing power outages in Golestan where the MOIS building is located. Multiple explosions hit Qeshm Island around 3:40 AM local time, with six locals reporting blasts and two injured hospitalized. IDF destroyed a 55-meter Hezbollah underground HQ with three living rooms under a construction factory 300m from a UNIFIL building.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The concurrent US strikes on Iran and IDF operations in Lebanon indicate a coordinated escalation against Iranian proxy networks across the region. Russian sustained pressure on Ukrainian infrastructure and the Italian mafia's attempt to procure drone ammunition highlight the expanding proliferation risks of the conflict.
